name: AmbientModules
description: A small collection of Rack modules inspired by Elta Music's SOLAR 42F ambient drone synthesizer.
author: Neil Baumberger

modules.name: Lunar50Drone
modules.description: 5-oscillator sawtooth drone voice with per-oscillator tuning, activation, trigger input and switchable frequency CV routing, a CV attenuverter, a shared Attack/Release envelope (gate, Hold, chainable Envelope In/Out), and a CV-controlled detune/FM knob

modules.name: LunarVCO
modules.description: AS3340-style VCO with 6 waveforms (3 fixed + 3 shaped: PWM square, saw-to-inv.saw and sine-to-saw morphs), octave/sub/lin-exp switches, hard sync, and a full ADSR envelope with Hold and Self-generation

modules.name: LunarPapaSrapa
modules.description: "Papa Srapa"-inspired noise/drone voice: FM/AM square oscillator driven by an internal modulator with a dedicated LFO output, independent white noise with sample & hold, and a shared Attack/Release envelope with Hold and chainable Envelope In/Out

modules.name: LunarSequencer
modules.description: 3-to-5-stage Buchla-inspired sequential voltage source with per-step CV and independent gate on/off, internal pulser or external clock with a Clock Out, and a switchable CV output range
